title: Minimum Number of Taps to Water a Garden
problemStatement: A one-dimensional garden extends from position 0 to N. Each tap waters an interval centered at its position. Determine the minimum number of taps that must be opened to water the entire garden. If impossible, print -1.
input: • First line contains integer N. • Second line contains N+1 integers representing the watering range of each tap.
output: Print the minimum number of taps required.
